_comment: Importable SNAPSHOT of the live default-branch (main) ruleset — kept faithful to the enforced state so re-applying it is idempotent (it must never silently re-tighten governance). Apply with: gh api repos/three-cubes/kairix/rulesets/<id> --method PUT --input .github/rulesets/main.json (or POST to create; requires Administration:Write). Governance model — tc-pipelines/governance/STANDARDS.md §4-§5: autonomous-on-green (required_approving_review_count 0) with code-owner review ONLY on CODEOWNERS-matched control-plane paths, and ZERO bypass actors (no admin bypass; humans hold the gate, never route around it). The merge_queue rule (grouping ALLGREEN) must be enabled via the web UI (Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> 'main' -> Add rule -> Require merge queue) and is intentionally omitted from this file because GitHub's REST rulesets API rejects it (422); it is therefore NOT round-tripped or verified by re-applying this snapshot.
name: main
